scope: V2 maintenance authority only; verified existing runtime mirrors, no runtime injection. RP3.A owner approval supersedes legacy-only ownership for these families.

REEL.meaning: Spoken Vietnamese written to be spoken aloud; breath, rhythm and conversational transitions. Not a short article read aloud.
REEL.representation: REEL means spoken Vietnamese with breath and conversational rhythm

mode_selection: Before Writer, retain the approved selected_mode when present; historical approvals without it retain existing plan format fallback. Platform is a delivery constraint, not a mode. No schema migration.

title_checks.meaning: Separate psychology, real numbered title frame (or declared self-made) and treatment columns. Verify library membership, not self-certification.
Address a specific supported audience context/moment/exact source quote in Zone A. V2 overrides legacy persona/occupation invention and creator-centered preference.
Understandable alone: topic and reader benefit immediately clear.
No internal role, process, pillar or formula labels in the public title.
Title and final hook consistent; do not spoil the withheld conclusion. Naming the topic/problem is allowed.
Title names the subject and earns the click; hook retains attention. Do not use hook withholding to make the title obscure.
REEL only: title and final spoken hook share the same idea, or explicitly justify their separation. Does not force articles into Reel.
Real separate table of 3–5 title options, with all three columns and verified references. For approved V2 execution the table is in the plan, not recreated in the draft.

title_failure: All eight false results block V2 PASS; malformed length fails closed. Three existing owner quality booleans remain separate, not a ninth title criterion. Legacy rubric exemptions do not remove any V2 transport slot.

severity.HARD BLOCK: Any of the nine categories always normalizes to blocking/REVISE regardless of reported PASS/advisory. A detected unsupported assertion must not be hidden as publication requirement.
severity.CREATIVE REVISE: Existing failed title/quality/plan fidelity or other declared blocking creative finding prevents PASS; repair only within existing authority.
severity.ADVISORY: Non-blocking suggestion with no unresolved protected defect; cannot override any required false check.
severity.PUBLICATION REQUIREMENT: Outstanding research/disclosure/publication prerequisite; separate from draft quality. Omit/soften unsupported assertions within intent or block. No permission to assert unsupported facts or publish.

unknown.history: Preserve original UNKNOWN. Existing audited reconciliation only, never a severity downgrade.

repair_authority: Classification is documentation, not an executable router. No new repair loop or authority. Writer cannot replace locked wording, plan, angle, evidence, state or approvals; existing maximum one rewrite unchanged.

locks.title: exact approved wording
locks.story: Optional; NONE valid. Preserve selected source/classification when used.

historical_word_counts.status: UNRESOLVED LEGACY GUIDANCE — benchmark/product decision required; no new universal hard blocker

required: the old seven-item prompt is superseded for V2 only
Target a supported A context, moment or exact quote instead of the legacy customer profile
For candidate-table rubric inspect the supplied plan, not duplicate tables in the article
Selected hook/title are exact approved wording; use them unchanged
REEL is not a short article read aloud
SHORT_ARTICLE uses written-content rules, not spoken-Reel rules
code ALWAYS forces REVISE, even if you report PASS or advisory severity
Never hide these defects inside free-form notes or label them creative_quality/voice/format/other
omit or soften unsupported assertions while preserving selected intent, or report BLOCKED_PENDING_RESEARCH
NONE does not need a story
Mất kết quả: UNKNOWN, không tự chạy lại
Critic PASS không phải human approval hay permission to publish

compatibility: Legacy seven-box prompt and eight-box library coexist historically. Preserve both, explicitly isolate via V2 override; this is not proof of legacy semantic consistency. Do not globally rewrite legacy.
